name: tech-text
title: Tech Text
description: A large single-word headline where the letter beneath the pointer switches from solid white to a dashed technical outline ringed by measuring lines and small size labels. Clicking or dragging a letter nudges it.
use: A technical or creative studio headline can trade a plain title for a letter that reveals its construction on hover.
avoid: Only one letter at a time reacts, the effect is lost on touch, and the tiny labels cannot be read at a distance.
a11y: The word is a single labelled image, so keyboard and screen-reader users get no access to the hover effect. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A large white sans-serif word sits alone on a dark stage. The letter the pointer touches becomes a hollow dashed outline, boxed by thin guide lines with small pixel measurements above it.
behaves: On hover the touched letter crossfades from solid to dashed vector strokes, gaining construction guides and a size label, and returns when the pointer leaves. A letter can be dragged aside and springs back.
customise: Text, font, size, colours, dash pattern, stroke width, reveal mode, specks, labels, dragging and intro style are props; the canvas drawing needs a source edit.
weight: moderate: Canvas redraw runs only on hover or while settling, and glyph sprites are cached.
